quest.title: About That Time We Saved the Tanuki Photo Board
quest.description: Kimura, the Doushin in charge of maintaining order at the Irodori Festival, seems to be having a hard time...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Recipe: Rainbow Aster x1

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: What a nice surprise meeting you guys here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Well, I heard that a certain well-known individual had made an appearance at the festival and taken quite a liking to the Tanuki photo board.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Since the Yashiro Commission is the host of this festival, I felt I simply had to come and meet them in person.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Red horns... If I'm not mistaken, you must be the esteemed Arataki Itto, leader of the widely renowned Arataki Gang, is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahahaha! Thoma, my bro, your eyes do not deceive you!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: And you are the housekeeper extraordinaire of the Kamisato Clan! You're quite the celebrity yourself, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Well, I'm flattered, Itto. And it's nice to meet you too, bro.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there's a serious bromance developing here.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I didn't expect to run into both Itto and the Traveler here.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I kind of count as the host here. So is anything wrong? Don't worry, you can tell me anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all Itto! He wants to—

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ah, no no no, it's no big deal. We were just about to have a duel, and we're trying to think what format it should take.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Oh... a duel...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: In that case, I have a suggestion. Since your duel is taking place at the Irodori Festival, why don't you have a volunteering competition?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Then you can both do your part for the Irodori Festival while settling your duel at the same time. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Volunteering competition? Hmm, sounds a little low-key. Not quite hard-core enough for the Arataki Gang...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #I give this idea an interest rating of two points. One for {NICKNAME}, one for Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Boss means, uh... two points out of a hundred.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, yeah, this job isn't the most high-stakes, that's for sure. It just takes a little patience and responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Also, since it's volunteering, by definition there's no remuneration. All you'll get is this special-edition drink from Sailing Breeze as a small token of appreciation...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: On second thought, this is nowhere near enough for the prestigious Arataki Gang. I don't know what I was thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, wait a sec... What was that part about the, uh, token of appreciation?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Oh, it's just a special-edition drink produced by Yae Publishing House and Sailing Breeze. It's really nothing special.

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Boss! That's the one!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: If we take this gig, we'll get that drink!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh... so uh, Thoma, my bro, my guy, my dude, maybe I didn't explain properly. When I said two points, that's out of a total of two.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: If there's one thing the Arataki Gang is known for, I kid you not, it's our patience and responsibility!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: It's an awesome idea, totally hard-core. Practically tailor-made just for me! Hahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's do this for our duel, it'll be amazing! Whoever volunteers the hardest wins! What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You didn't seem too interested in it just a second ago.

choices.text: There's actually no need for the duel after all.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, this is the mighty Arataki "Above All, Bold-Blooded" Itto you're talking to here! I'm a say-what-I-mean, mean-what-I-say, might-sound-mean-but-I-say-it-anyway kinda guy. And I say, we're gonna have this duel!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: AKA, doesn't-want-people-to-know-he's-only-doing-it-for-the-drinks kinda guy.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: If it's decided, then allow me to take the role of your judge.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: The volunteer work is simple. You just need to give your help to people who need it during the festival.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: I will assign some job requests that I've already received to you.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: If you're ready, we can begin.

choices.text: If you want that drink, just ask Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: So many complaints... What should I do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: Ah, are you the Traveler who my superiors said would come and help us out?

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: You came at the perfect time. We're facing a small problem here.

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: As you know, the Irodori Festival is underway.

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: In addition to all the things on sale, there's a lot of free entertainment programs available.

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: But today, we received numerous complaints that a group of people has been hogging the Tanuki photo board.

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: They won't leave, so no one else gets to use it.

dialogues.speaker: Kimura
dialogues.text: *sigh* What a headache.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Well... we tried talking to them, but the original point of these entertainment facilities was to let people freely enjoy the festival.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: So in principle, it's open to everyone, and there's no time limit on usage.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: This means that as long as they haven't done anything technically illegal, even if they keep hogging it...

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: ...there is nothing we can do.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: So, can you try negotiating with them for us?

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: If these complaints can't be resolved, and Madam Kujou finds out...

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: ...I'll lose my bonus this month for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hogging a photo board, huh? We know who would do something like that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Should we go and have a look, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Thank you so much! You'll find them by the Tanuki photo board just east of the square.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: Uh... arrest them? Well, it would solve the immediate problem...

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: But don't you think that if the Tenryou Commission starts arresting people without good cause, we'll soon have a bigger problem on our hands?

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: The first thing we tried was negotiating with them. But ultimately, these facilities are open to everyone, and there's no time limit on usage.

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: This means that as long as they haven't done anything technically illegal, even if they keep hogging it...

response.speaker: Kimura
response.text: ...there is nothing we can do.

talks.objective: Go to the Tanuki Photo Board

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey hey, Traveler, Paimon! What's happening!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You came here for the Irodori Festival, too? Oh, see, I knew it, great minds think alike, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're such a child.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here to take care of a little problem.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, oh right. Well, who's got a problem? The Arataki Gang considers it our born duty to help those in need!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Arataki Gang is the problem!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Tenryou Commission said you guys have been hogging the photo board and nobody else has had a chance to use it.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh... uh... well... no we haven't...

choices.text: They've received quite a few complaints.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Uhh... it's kind of a long story. Mamoru, you're up! Explain the situation to these good people!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Yes, Boss!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: The story starts two months ago, when we first found out about the Irodori Festival...

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: As everyone knows, this is a festival all about showcasing culture, with books on all kinds of topics on display and for sale.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Our boss is very forward-thinking. He thought we should seize this golden opportunity to publish some material introducing the Arataki Gang and help craft a glorious public image.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: He also said we can make some money out of it to support ourselves.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahem, heh... that wasn't the main reason, obviously...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course that was your main reason!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: At first, we had plenty of time. In two months, Boss planned to write 60 pages.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: But one month in, and he'd written a grand total of one line.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Well, I mean... Come on, gotta make sure the quality is up to scratch...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: More like worst procrastinator ever!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: So, we cut some of the planned content, and figured it would still be fine if we could put out 20 pages in the next month.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: But the day after that, the boss got hold of this card game called Genius Invokation TCG. Everyone loved it.

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: It felt like we only played a few rounds, but before we knew it, half a month had gone by! I'm telling you, this game — it's pretty incredible.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahem... I was just gathering inspiration for my writing... What?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure you were... Inspiration that has absolutely nothing to do with what you were writing about!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: So then we only had two weeks left. No way was that gonna be enough time to publish a book.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Boss said we should just make a colorful flyer instead. That way, we'd only need to think of a slogan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That makes more sense. It shouldn't take too long to think of a slogan, right?

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Yeah, it didn't take long at all. We came up with 30 slogans between us in just half a day.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: But 30 was too many, and we couldn't agree with each other on which one to use. It took us a week to make the final decision.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: That was when we realized we'd have to pay an expensive express fee for the printing, because there was so little time left.

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: And... we couldn't afford it!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You gotta take it slow if you wanna do something well. Pay an express fee, and they're gonna do a rush job, and then there's gonna be all sorts of problems...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The Arataki Gang only puts out the very best into the world! And that is why I decided to give up on that project.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That, yup, well said! You gotta do what keeps you happy, same goes for humans and oni alike.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: And it's not every day you get to go to an Irodori Festival, right? So priority number one right now is enjoying ourselves to the max!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And the way you chose to enjoy yourselves was... to commandeer a novelty photo board?

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Um... so, at first, Boss brought us here to buy some drinks. He said there was some sort of Irodori Festival limited-edition soft drink available.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That's right, this ain't no ordinary drink either. It's a special-edition joint creation of Sailing Breeze and Yae Publishing House, as featured in the popular novel, "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... What?

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: But when we got to the festival, the staff wouldn't let us in because of our unusual outfits.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: They said we had to show up looking like our normal selves before they'd let us in...

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: We'd invested a lot of time and money into the way we looked! And then they accuse us of spoiling the image of the city.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: One thing led to another, and by the time we finally got to Sailing Breeze's booth, all the drinks were sold out.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: We were pretty disappointed, but there was nothing we could do. Then we saw this photo board on the way back, Boss said we can't let the trip go to waste, so—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you decided to take over the whole area for your own use?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha... I beg to differ. It's public property, we didn't "commandeer" anything!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: We're just making sure public resources get used to the max.

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: Yeah! Boss is right. We're the ones making the most out of this thing!

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: Never let a single moment in your life go to waste. That's our policy in the Arataki Gang, and we're out here making sure this photo board gets the most out of its lifespan, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, brother... what a noble cause...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You could also go buy some books.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: But we spent so much money on our appearance... We only had enough left for one of those drinks.

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: We don't have anywhere near enough to buy books.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you can't just take over this photo board for yourselves because it's free and you don't have any money. Other people have the right to use it, too.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I guess when you put it like that... I can kinda see where you're coming from.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So come on! Let someone else have their turn, already!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Um... ummm...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But you know full well that the Arataki Gang has a reputation to uphold.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If I say I'm gonna make the most out of this board, then I have to live up to my words.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If we just scrap our plan like that, we'd be going against our word. A gang's gotta have integrity, or it does huge damage to your prestige!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That being said... we won't have to worry about any of that if we can settle this the Arataki way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "The Arataki way," huh? Paimon has a bad feeling about this.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: So I, Arataki "Numero Uno" Itto, challenge you to an all-out, no-holds-barred, anything-goes duel!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If you win, I will leave this board alone.

choices.text: ...Wait, do you mean a beetle fight?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Beetle fighting is an awesome idea! Just so happens I caught myself a true beast of an Onikabuto the other day, I call it "Demon of Darkness"!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Unfortunately, I did not bring Demon of Darkness with me today... so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, that's a relief...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: So how are we gonna do this duel? Uh, let's think... Umm, this is a tough nut to crack, lemme think for a second...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, look, isn't that Thoma? Guess he's here for the festival, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Why don't we ask Thoma how to do this duel, {NICKNAME}? Paimon bets he'll have a ton of ideas.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thoma! Thoma!!! Over here!!!

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

choices.text: Great! Let's have a beetle battle!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: The volunteer work is simple. You just need to give your help to people who need it during the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I will assign some job requests that I've already received to you.

dialogues.speaker: Hiraizumi
dialogues.text: I didn't expect the Irodori Festival to be so busy this time...

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: You've finished already? Wow, you work hard!

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: You're wonderful people, all you volunteers. Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: Are you the volunteers? Perfect timing.

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: As you can see, there's a lot of dust and dead leaves around my stand.

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: I've just been so busy with my customers these past few days. I keep meaning to sweep up, but I just haven't found a spare moment...

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: Can you help me clean up the place, please? Thank you so much!

talks.objective: Help to clean the area around the stall
Help to clean the area around the stall

dialogues.speaker: Takeuchi
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be the volunteers here to save the day.

dialogues.speaker: Takeuchi
dialogues.text: You must be tired. Put down the goods and have a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Takeuchi
dialogues.text: I heard the Yashiro Commission has arranged for Sailing Breeze to prepare some special drinks for the volunteers as a way of saying thank-you.

dialogues.speaker: Takeuchi
dialogues.text: Soy milk is actually one of the ingredients for the drink. It's freshly made every day!

dialogues.speaker: Takeuchi
dialogues.text: In fact, the last batch of soy milk we processed has just been sent over. You'll get to try it very soon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? So Sailing Breeze's special drink... has soy milk in it!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Itto won't be able to drink that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hurry, we've gotta get to Sailing Breeze before he does...

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #Hey, {F#Miss}{M#Mister}! Come and help me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Kujirai, fancy meeting you here at the festival. But we don't have time to play games with you right now.

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: I'm not playing games! I'm in trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: I heard they were selling a new kind of Temari at the festival, so I came to check it out...

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: But I couldn't find it anywhere, and then I went and lost my current one...

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: *sobbing* It's gotta be nearby. I still had it a moment ago...

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #Can you help me, {F#Miss}{M#Mister}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So basically, every time we run into you, we have to go Temari-hunting...

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: I'm so grateful to have you helping out...

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: Great! Now I can play the Temari game again!

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #Thanks, {F#Miss}{M#Mister}!

dialogues.speaker: Hiraizumi
dialogues.text: Are you the festival volunteers?

dialogues.speaker: Hiraizumi
dialogues.text: Great. I was just wondering what to do about these goods. It's been really busy lately, and all the workers at the port are swamped.

dialogues.speaker: Hiraizumi
dialogues.text: But I have to get all this fresh soy milk delivered to the warehouse as soon as possible. It'll go bad if it's left outside too long.

dialogues.speaker: Hiraizumi
dialogues.text: Can you please help me take it to the warehouse? My coworker, Takeuchi, will be waiting for you there. Thank you so much.

talks.objective: Take the goods to the warehouse

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: Did you find my Temari yet?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! What took you so long? I've been here ages — completed my tasks a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So there you have it, when volunteering's the name of the game, no one volunteers harder than Arataki Itto! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #You lose, I win, {NICKNAME}, and to the victor go the special-edition spoils....

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Behold, the drink of champions, created by Sailing Breeze in collaboration with Yae Publishing House, and as featured in the popular work, "Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?"!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: All this talk's making me thirsty — don't mind if I do! Hahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Drink of champions, it's time to come home!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Glug, glug, ahhh... Itto downs the drink in one go.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh! Wooh! That's the good stuff...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: That was a mighty fine drink... Although maybe it was a little past its prime...

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Boss, they said they think there might be, uh...

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: B—Beans in the drink!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: A mighty figure falls to the ground.

response.speaker: Genta
response.text: Ah! The boss is down! The boss is down!

response.speaker: Mamoru
response.text: Quick! Get him to a doctor!

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: What's wrong? Can't Arataki Itto drink soy products?

response.speaker: Akira
response.text: He's allergic to beans!

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Oh, my goodness... Okay! Quick, grab Itto and follow me. I'll get a doctor — I sure hope it's not too serious...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: #I'm sorry, {NICKNAME}. I didn't even consider this possibility. It was all my fault.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Leave Itto to me. I'll make sure he stands again.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Don't worry. I'll see you later.

response.speaker: Karpillia
response.text: So, your friend is allergic to beans. It's a very rare condition, though I have heard about it.

response.speaker: Karpillia
response.text: I'm so sorry that our drink caused such a problem. I feel terrible.

response.speaker: Karpillia
response.text: If you don't mind, please take this. This is a special drink formula with no soy milk.

response.speaker: Karpillia
response.text: I could see that your friend enjoyed this drink a lot. Although it tastes slightly different without the soy milk, I'm sure this version will be more suitable for your friend.

response.speaker: Karpillia
response.text: Please accept it, along with our sincere apologies.

choices.text: There are soybeans in the drink!

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: *crying* Where'd my Temari go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! Well, if it isn't Arataki Itto and his gang!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew it was gonna be them! Let's go and see what all this is about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, one last job!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We need to help move some goods at the port. Let's go.
